clients.doc: The per-invocation context the shim passes to the handler.

methods.name: log
methods.signature: log(...args: unknown[]): void
methods.doc: Writes the arguments as one log line at level INFO, as console.log does.

methods.name: invoke
methods.signature: invoke<I = unknown, O = unknown>(alias: string, input: I): Promise<O>
methods.doc: Calls the function that the link named alias targets, and returns its result parsed from JSON, or null when it returns nothing. The target's event.data is input, except that an object with a top-level `data` or `specversion` key is taken as the whole CloudEvent, so event.data is only its `data`: send such an object inside an envelope, as `{ specversion: '1.0', data: { data: [1], page: 2 } }`. The link's timeout, 30 seconds by default, bounds the call. Fails with the HTTP status 403 when the function declares no link named alias, 409 when the target serves HTTP, 422 when input does not match the target's contract, and the target's status when its handler fails, such as 500.

methods.name: fetch
methods.signature: fetch(alias: string, path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response>
methods.doc: Sends an HTTP request to the function that the link named alias targets, which serves HTTP, and returns its reply as a Response, whatever its status. path starts with "/" and may carry a query; init sets the method, the headers and the body, as for the global fetch. The request body and the reply are each at most 1 MiB, and the link's timeout, 30 seconds by default, bounds the call. Fails with the HTTP status 403 when the function declares no link named alias, and 409 when the target does not serve HTTP.

methods.name: remainingMs
methods.signature: remainingMs(): number | null
methods.doc: The whole milliseconds left before the call's deadline, 0 once it has passed, or null when the call has none.

clients.name: kv
clients.doc: The key-value tables that the function binds, by alias: read, write and list their keys.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(binding: string, key: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null>
methods.doc: The key's value as bytes, or null when the key does not exist.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.signature: getEntry(binding: string, key: string): Promise<KVEntry | null>
methods.doc: The key's value with its version, or null when the key does not exist.

methods.name: getText
methods.signature: getText(binding: string, key: string): Promise<string | null>
methods.doc: The key's value decoded as UTF-8 text, or null when the key does not exist.

methods.name: getJSON
methods.signature: getJSON<T = unknown>(binding: string, key: string): Promise<T | null>
methods.doc: The key's value parsed as JSON, or null when the key does not exist. Write it with put(binding, key, JSON.stringify(value)).

methods.name: put
methods.signature: put(binding: string, key: string, value: Uint8Array | string, opts?: PutOptions): Promise<void>
methods.doc: Writes the value. opts.ttl, in whole seconds, sets the key's expiry; a put without it leaves the key with none. Only the table's owner and the writers that a RolesAssignment names can write.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.signature: putIfAbsent(binding: string, key: string, value: Uint8Array | string, opts?: PutOptions): Promise<string | null>
methods.doc: Creates the key: its new version, or null when it exists (an expired key does not).

methods.name: compareAndSet
methods.signature: compareAndSet(binding: string, key: string, value: Uint8Array | string, version: string, opts?: PutOptions): Promise<string | null>
methods.doc: Replaces the key while it is at version: its new version, or null when it is not.

methods.name: del
methods.signature: del(binding: string, key: string): Promise<void>
methods.doc: Deletes the key.

methods.name: delIf
methods.signature: delIf(binding: string, key: string, version: string): Promise<boolean>
methods.doc: Deletes the key while it is at version, as a lease holder releases what it holds: true when it did.

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list(binding: string, prefix?: string): Promise<string[]>
methods.doc: The keys that start with prefix; without a prefix, every key of the table.

clients.name: blob
clients.doc: The Bucket prefixes that the function binds, by alias: read, write, delete and list their objects, whose keys are relative to the binding's prefix.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(binding: string, key: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null>
methods.doc: The object's content as bytes, or null when the object does not exist.

methods.name: put
methods.signature: put(binding: string, key: string, value: Uint8Array): Promise<void>
methods.doc: Writes the object, replacing any object with that key. The value is at most 64 MiB, and at most the Bucket's spec.quota.maxObjectBytes when that is set: a larger one fails with the HTTP status 413. Only the prefix's owner and the writers that a RolesAssignment names can write.

methods.name: del
methods.signature: del(binding: string, key: string): Promise<void>
methods.doc: Deletes the object, and fails with the HTTP status 404 when it does not exist. Only the prefix's owner and the writers that a RolesAssignment names can delete.

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list(binding: string, prefix?: string): Promise<string[]>
methods.doc: The keys that start with prefix; without a prefix, every key under the binding's prefix.

methods.name: signedUrl
methods.signature: signedUrl(binding: string, key: string, opts?: SignOptions): Promise<string>
methods.doc: A presigned URL that lets its holder send an opts.method request, GET by default, for the object until opts.expiry passes: a duration such as "10m" or "1h30m", in whole seconds from 1s to 168h, or 15 minutes when unset. Any other expiry, "" included, fails with the HTTP status 400. A PUT or DELETE URL needs permission to write the prefix, and a PUT URL fails with the HTTP status 403 when the Bucket sets maxObjectBytes or a size quota applies to the Bucket or the prefix, since funcd could not enforce it on the upload. No blob store that funcd opens signs URLs, so a call that passes these checks fails with the HTTP status 503.

clients.name: sql
clients.doc: The SQL databases that the function binds, by alias: query reads rows, queryValues keeps every column of a join, and execute writes in one transaction. A call fails with the HTTP status 503 while the database's engine is not Ready, or when a statement runs past funcd's SQL call timeout, 30 seconds by default.

methods.name: query
methods.signature: query(alias: string, sql: string, params?: SQLParams): Promise<SQLRow[]>
methods.doc: Runs one statement that reads, and returns its rows as objects keyed by column name; with a duplicate column name, the last one wins. params fill the statement's ? placeholders in order, or its :name placeholders from one object. A statement that writes, or that the database refuses, fails with the HTTP status 400.

methods.name: queryValues
methods.signature: queryValues(alias: string, sql: string, params?: SQLParams): Promise<SQLValues>
methods.doc: Runs one statement that reads, and returns its column names and its rows as arrays of values in column order, so every column of a join is kept. params and failures are as for query.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(alias: string, sql: string, params?: SQLParams): Promise<SQLExecResult>
methods.doc: Runs one statement, or a list of up to 500 statements, in one transaction that applies all or none of them. Returns the statement's result, or one result for each statement of a list: rowsAffected and lastInsertId, with columns and values for a RETURNING statement. A statement that the database refuses fails the call with the HTTP status 400. Only the database's owner and the writers that a RolesAssignment names can execute.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(alias: string, statements: SQLStatement[]): Promise<SQLExecResult[]>
methods.doc: Runs one statement, or a list of up to 500 statements, in one transaction that applies all or none of them. Returns the statement's result, or one result for each statement of a list: rowsAffected and lastInsertId, with columns and values for a RETURNING statement. A statement that the database refuses fails the call with the HTTP status 400. Only the database's owner and the writers that a RolesAssignment names can execute.

clients.name: config
clients.doc: The keys of the ConfigMaps that the function binds, with the values that the worker got when it started. A key that starts with FUNCD_ is left out, since funcd reserves that prefix. A key that a bound Secret also holds is left out too, and ctx.secret reads the Secret's value. While funcd's S3 gateway runs, a function that binds a Bucket reads the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY that funcd issues it, in place of a ConfigMap's.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(key: string): string | undefined
methods.doc: The key's value, or undefined when list() does not include the key.

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list(): string[]
methods.doc: The keys of the bound ConfigMaps, sorted, without the keys left out.

clients.name: secret
clients.doc: The keys and values of the Secrets that the function binds, which funcd reads at each get or list, with no cache, so a changed Secret shows at the next read. A key that starts with FUNCD_ is never read: get returns undefined for it, and list leaves it out.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(key: string): Promise<string | undefined>
methods.doc: The key's value, or undefined when no bound Secret holds the key, the key starts with FUNCD_, or a bound Secret does not exist. When two Secrets hold the key, the later one in spec.bindings.secret wins. Fails with the HTTP status 403 when a Policy forbids the function to read a bound Secret.

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list(): Promise<string[]>
methods.doc: The keys that the bound Secrets hold, sorted, except a key that starts with FUNCD_. Fails with the HTTP status 403 when a Policy forbids the function to read a bound Secret, and 404 when a bound Secret does not exist.

methods.name: put
methods.signature: put(binding: string, key: string, value: string): Promise<void>
methods.doc: Writes key in Secret `binding`, which the function binds and may write: its owner, or a principal a writer role names. Every function that binds it reads the value at its next read.

methods.name: del
methods.signature: del(binding: string, key: string): Promise<void>
methods.doc: Removes key from Secret `binding`, as put may write it; a key the Secret lacks is no error.

clients.name: lake
clients.doc: The Lakes that the function binds, by alias: the address of each Lake's gateway, and the token that the gateway accepts from the function.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(alias: string): LakeEndpoint
methods.doc: The gateway of the Lake bound as alias: url, its address as host:port, and token, the token that it accepts from the function. Throws an Error naming the alias when the function binds no Lake with that alias.
